verdicts.reason: A keeps the full-width white logo bar and a big readable headline, but the CTA pill is undersized and pushed into a cramped bottom-left corner beside 'Ships late June', and the body copy is tiny and jammed between the headline and the button. B's white logo band stops short of the right edge, leaving an odd navy notch, and the orange divider collides with the top of the CTA. B's body copy also sits right under the headline and the bottom third of the canvas is dead navy space.
